title: 20 Euro Cents - Beatrix (1st map)

composition.text: Nordic gold (89% Copper, 5% Aluminium, 5% Zinc, 1% Tin)

obverse.description: Profile of Queen Beatrix encircled by twelve stars of Europe.

reverse.description: A map of the European continent is represented on a dynamic canvas composed of the twelve stars of the European Union.

comments:
This coin was engraved by the Utrecht mint by several engravers in the following periods:

  • 1999: bow bandaged and cocked; (holder)
  • 2000: banded and cocked bow and star; (interim)
  • 2001 - 2002: cluster; (incumbent)
  • 2003 - 2013: sails; Maarten Brouwer (incumbent)
